newsitem.title: USA: Four Corners 750 MW coal unit to shut for 3 weeks.
newsitem.headline: Four Corners 750 MW coal unit to shut for 3 weeks.

text.p: The 750 megawatt (MW) unit 5 at the Four Corners coal-fired power plant in New Mexico will be shut Friday for three weeks, a spokesman for the plant's operator, Arizona Public Service Co (APS), said Wednesday.
The unit needs work to repair a ground, or dead spot, in its high pressure generator field, the spokesman said.
If not repaired, the unit would be at greater risk of a short circuit or other more serious problems, he added.
Four Corners' other 750 MW unit plus a 245 MW unit and two 185 MW units were said to be operating normally.
Arizona Public Service Co, a unit of Pinnacle West Capital, operates Four Corners and owns units 1, 2 and 3 along with 15 percent of units 4 and 5.
Edison International's Southern California Edison owns 48 percent of units 4 and 5.
